scientific_integrity: The all-graph proof derives pair covariances by exact shared-edge orientation classification and counts motif copies. The finite checker corroborates but does not replace proof; no publication, authorship, or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs with independent fair orientations only; no all-order independence classification, no biased-edge extension and no independent mathematical audit. The complete-tournament moment is established prior work; older arbitrary-graph equivalents remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Four-cycle orientation dependence is controlled by two graph motifs
